source.book: Doctor on Duty Treatment Guide, 3rd Edition 2024–25
source.heading: BRUCELLOSIS

sourceDivisions.heading: UNCOMPLICATED BRUCELLA DISEASE — acute without focal disease
items: PLUS Streptomycin 1 g IM OD × 3 weeks
OSE Gentamicin 5 mg/kg IM/IV OD × 7–10 days
OSE Rifampicin 300 mg PO twice daily × 6 weeks

sourceDivisions.heading: COMPLICATED BRUCELLA DISEASE — focal disease
items: Doxycycline 100 mg twice daily for at least 3–6 months
PLUS Rifampicin 300 mg twice daily for at least 3–6 months
PLUS Streptomycin 1 g IM OD × 2 weeks
OSE Gentamicin 5 mg/kg IM/IV OD × 7–10 days
FOR NEUROBRUCELLOSIS Ceftriaxone 1–2 g IM/IV OD × 3–6 months
